notes.title: [NEWS] The Echoes of Twilight Resound
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035651/b072c80457520e087a66efcc9889758d43a23d21.png[/img]

My lady,

May I take but a moment of your precious time? I bring delightful news—[u][b]the Original Soundtrack of 'Phantom of the Twilight' is now officially released.[/b][/u]

Each melody carries the essence of twilight, interwoven with memories of your journey. Whether reminiscing in solitude or stepping toward new adventures, may these harmonies be your companion.

Furthermore, a special bundle is available, offering the most favorable price for those who wish to embrace the music in its entirety.

I sincerely hope you will enjoy this gift of sound, my lady. The echoes of twilight now belong to you.

With utmost devotion,
Charlie

notes.title: [NEWS] The Melody of Twilight Awakens
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035651/b072c80457520e087a66efcc9889758d43a23d21.png[/img]

My lady,

May I once again request a moment of your precious time? I bring tidings that will surely delight you—[u][b]the Original Soundtrack of 'Phantom of the Twilight' will be released next week.[/b][/u]

As the echoes of twilight resound, each note shall weave together the essence of this world, evoking the memories of your journey. I sincerely hope that these melodies will accompany you, whether in the quiet moments of reflection or in the anticipation of new adventures.

Please stay tuned for the coming release, my lady. The music of the twilight is soon to be yours.

With utmost respect,
Charlie

notes.title: [NEWS] A New Dawn for Romance: Phantom of the Twilight Has Arrived!
notes.content:
My lady,

With great reverence, I bring forth news that I hope will stir your heart. At long last, [u][b]"Phantom of the Twilight"[/b][/u] steps from the shadows, its mysteries now yours to behold.

For 14 enchanting days, a 15% launch discount awaits, a token of our gratitude for your enduring patience and faith. It is a rare moment indeed, and one we hope you shall seize with eager hands.

Every choice, every word, every fleeting glance within this world was crafted with devotion, that you might lose yourself in its depths. May you delight in its beauty, savor the romance, and linger in the company of its unforgettable characters.

Should you be moved to share your impressions — through thoughtful words or spirited videos — we would be honored to hear them. Your insights kindle the flames of inspiration and help pave the way for even more wondrous Otome tales to come.

The veil has lifted. The stage is set. The twilight is yours.

With enduring devotion,
Charlie

notes.title: [NEWS] The Twilight Approaches Its Grand Unveiling
notes.content:
My lady,

Once more, I humbly request a moment of your esteemed attention. I bring news that I believe shall please you greatly: [u][b]"Phantom of the Twilight" will at last be fully available to you on December 16th, PST[/b][/u].
It has been quite a journey, and I cannot help but feel a profound gratitude towards you and all those who have so patiently awaited this day.

Your unwavering support and understanding have been most gracious, and I am confident that your patience shall be rewarded. As the shadows recede and the veil lifts, may you find yourself fully immersed in this grand narrative, savoring every carefully wrought detail and reveling in the mysteries that lie within.

Should you, my lady, or those you deem worthy choose to share your impressions, whether by penning thoughtful reviews or crafting review videos, I invite you to make use of the link provided below. Your insights will be most valuable and will no doubt guide others through the twilight.

Link: https://linktr.ee/smilegate.support


As ever, I remain at your service and stand ready to assist with any further inquiries or needs you might have.

With deepest respect,
Charlie

notes.title: Stretch Goal is Now Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035651/00f5366a0f5838b7f5e4ffb49d5e360e02f9aefd.png[/img]

My lady,

May I take a moment of your precious time to share some exciting news? In honor of our participation in Next Fest, I, your humble servant Charlie, am thrilled to announce the opening of a Stretch Goal for our beloved game.

Based on the number of wishlists added, we will unlock more content for you to enjoy. It is my hope that you, with your exquisite taste and discerning eye, will find these rewards as delightful as I do.

Stretch Goal Roadmap:

[olist]
[*] 5,000 Wishlists: Original Wallpaper Pack DLC
[*] 10,000 Wishlists: Special Wallpaper DLC 1
[*] 15,000 Wishlists: Special Wallpaper DLC 2
[*] 20,000 Wishlists: Community Item with Trading Cards
[/olist]

Your support, my lady, means everything to us. The higher our wishlist count, the greater the treasures that await!

As always, I am here at your service, and I look forward to bringing you the joys of these new adventures.

With deepest respect,
Charlie

notes.title: Phantom of the Twilight Demo is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035651/8097a00274bab2d04d76493b5dd721c08873dc73.png[/img]

My lady,

A moment of your precious time, if I may. It is with great pleasure that I, your humble servant Charlie, inform you that the demo for "Phantom of the Twilight" has been unveiled to the public. As you traverse through the shadowed halls and enigmatic realms within this extraordinary narrative, I trust you will find yourself most captivated.

You, my lady, with your impeccable taste and discerning eye, will surely appreciate the intricate details and the compelling storyline woven into this demo. It is but a mere taste of the grandeur that awaits. Should the experience be to your liking, I implore you to add the game to your wishlist. This simple act ensures you will be among the first to be notified when the full game is released, allowing you to continue your journey without unnecessary delay.

I am, as always, at your service, ready to assist with any inquiries or further needs you might have. Enjoy the demo, my lady, and remember, the shadows hold secrets awaiting your discovery.

With deepest respect,
Charlie
